##### Project general facts

Sea La Vie is a captivating waterfront destination that redefines contemporary living with effortless elegance. Rising as a striking collection of towers along the bay, it offers a refined portfolio of one, two, three, and four-bedroom apartments, along with duplexes and lofts, each designed to embrace the surrounding waters. Blending bold architecture with a concept inspired by the sea, this vibrant development promises a lifestyle where luxury and nature come together in perfect harmony.

Residents are welcomed into a vibrant, health-conscious community built to nurture mind, body, and soul at every turn. A stunning swimming pool, dedicated wellness spaces, and beautifully landscaped promenades create a resort-like atmosphere for relaxation and recreation. Thoughtfully designed communal areas and waterfront walkways make it effortless to embrace an active, social, and truly rejuvenating lifestyle every day.

Inside, every home is a masterclass in comfort, featuring hi-tech fixtures and fittings paired with an abundance of natural light. Sea-inspired hues and creative lighting bring a soothing, sophisticated ambiance to each room, while sleek modern kitchens and premium finishes elevate everyday living. Elegant furnishings and thoughtful design details throughout ensure a relaxing, luxurious atmosphere in every apartment.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Yas Island, a sprawling leisure and entertainment destination that has garnered global acclaim, this exceptional location covers a vast area and offers a wide array of world-class attractions. The renowned Yas Marina Circuit hosts the exhilarating Formula 1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, attracting racing enthusiasts from around the world.

The location is distinguished by its extraordinary attractions, including Ferrari World Abu Dhabi, an indoor theme park dedicated to the legendary Italian sports car manufacturer, featuring thrilling rides and captivating exhibits. Yas Waterworld offers a refreshing escape with exhilarating water slides and rides suitable for all ages, incorporating Emirati culture and traditions into its design to create a one-of-a-kind experience.

For those seeking a residence that embodies refined elegance, coastal living, and a prime Abu Dhabi address, Yas Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class entertainment, natural beauty, and a prestigious location makes it one of the region's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of island living — vibrant, connected and effortlessly refined.
